title: EliminationReceiptV1
description: Host-issued residual elimination receipt for accepted turn steps. AuthorityEffect: None.

elimination_receipt_id.description: Layer A domain digest of identity fields.

packet_id.description: Digest of the evaluated task packet.

eliminated_obstruction_ids.description: Obstruction IDs eliminated in this turn step (sorted unique).

prior_residual_colour.description: Residual colour prior to turn step evaluation.

new_residual_colour.description: Residual colour after turn step evaluation.

evidence_root.description: SHA-256 digest of content-addressed replayable evidence.

dual_witness_ref.description: SHA-256 digest of dual-witness certificate. Required if new_residual_colour is Exact.

authority_effect.description: Must be None. Elimination receipts record lab residual accounting only.

$comment: Elimination receipts are host-authored upon verifying an elimination step. Model never authors elimination receipts. AuthorityEffect is const None.
